title: RNA polymerase II initiation factors show different dynamic behaviour upon induced transcription in live cells
authors: Oravecz A; Tassy O; Conic S; Oulad-Abdelghani M; Molina N; Tora L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究活细胞中RNA聚合酶II起始因子在转录激活时的动态行为，虽涉及转录因子与启动子DNA的互作，但主要基于活细胞成像和动力学模型，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未聚焦TF-DNA结合位点或三维互作机制。
abstract: Transcription by RNA polymerase II (Pol II) requires the ordered action of general transcription factors (GTFs) forming the pre-initiation complex (PIC). How these events unfold kinetically remains unclear. Upon transcription activation, we observe coordinated recruitment of Pol II and GTFs together with chromatin decompaction. Pol II and its Ser5-phosphorylated form accumulate and persist at promoters, whereas TFIIB and TFIIF engage transiently, revealing distinct dynamic regimes. We find specific residence kinetics consistent with rapid exchange of GTFs and a more stable initiating Pol II population. A quantitative kinetic model recapitulates the temporal ordering and relative amplitudes of factor recruitment, predicts recruitment times, and links transient GTF engagement to sustained Pol II occupancy. Steady state measurements and transcription inhibition corroborate model predictions. These results uncover a dynamic hierarchy in human PIC assembly and establish a quantitative framework that connects factor exchange kinetics to the regulation of Pol II activity in living cells.
abstract_zh: RNA聚合酶II（Pol II）的转录需要通用转录因子（GTFs）形成预起始复合物（PIC）的有序作用。这些事件在动力学上如何展开仍不清楚。在转录激活时，我们观察到Pol II和GTFs的协同募集以及染色质去压缩。Pol II及其Ser5磷酸化形式在启动子处积累并持续存在，而TFIIB和TFIIF则短暂参与，揭示了不同的动态模式。我们发现特定的驻留动力学与GTFs的快速交换和更稳定的起始型Pol II群体一致。一个定量动力学模型重现了因子募集的时间顺序和相对幅度，预测了募集时间，并将短暂的GTF参与与持续的Pol II占据联系起来。稳态测量和转录抑制实验证实了模型预测。这些结果揭示了人类PIC组装中的动态层级，并建立了一个定量框架，将因子交换动力学与活细胞中Pol II活性的调控联系起来。
